research.title: Preprocessing and Evaluation for Support Request Classification
bullets: Implemented assigned text normalization and label mapping routines for support request classification using preprocessing rules specified by the research team.
Ran prescribed logistic regression experiments with word frequency features and compiled confusion matrices to support review of commonly confused request categories.

work.title: Inventory Records and Order Processing
bullets: Checked incoming delivery paperwork against purchase orders, recorded discrepancies, and routed incomplete documentation to the appropriate staff members for follow-up.
Maintained inventory logs, organized order records, and prepared routine handover notes covering pending deliveries and unresolved stock discrepancies.

projects.title: TF-IDF Baseline for Product Review Sentiment Classification
bullets: Implemented a sentiment classification baseline using TF-IDF features and logistic regression, fitting the vocabulary exclusively on the training partition.
Evaluated predictions with precision, recall, and macro F1, then inspected misclassified reviews for negation, mixed sentiment, and uncommon vocabulary.
